Mountain grave

Type: Structure | Internal ID: mountaingrave | Location: Mountains | Resources: Bone fragments, ,, Silver necklace

Introduction. Mountain graves are Points of interest found in the Mountains. They consist of a small circle of stones of various sizes.

Resources. A skeleton is buried at the center of the grave, at a depth of about 4 to 5 pickaxe hits. It can be picked for one Bone fragments and one Silver necklace with a 50.6% chance to drop.
